intro.title: Build a shopping cart quantity manager
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a shopping cart quantity manager that allows users to increase, decrease, and reset the quantity of an item. You'll learn how to use JavaScript state to track and update the quantity value dynamically. The main technologies involved are JavaScript variables, event handlers, and DOM manipulation to reflect changes on the page. By the end, you'll have a functional interface that responds to user clicks and maintains the correct count.
intro.usecase: This quantity manager pattern appears in virtually every e-commerce platform where users adjust item quantities in their shopping cart. You'll see this exact UI component on sites like Amazon, Target, or Shopify stores when customers increase or decrease quantities before checkout. As a developer, you'll implement similar controls for subscription services where users modify plan quantities, or in restaurant apps where customers adjust meal portions. Mastering this pattern is essential for building any interactive shopping experience where users need to modify item counts in real-time.
